hypotheses.text: Passing to Kai Nakamura (CM) instead would have created a higher-probability chance or reduced turnover risk compared with the low-probability shot, explaining whether the decision to shoot was suboptimal.
Theo Varga carrying the ball forward instead would have improved shooting angle/space and increased goal probability over the immediate shot, showing if taking extra dribbles mattered.

If Kofi Asante-Rhys (LB, home) had been 3 m closer to Varga, the defender pressure would have meaningfully lowered the shot's success probability, explaining how defensive positioning changed the outcome.
